notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «كلاهما عن الشيباني», written once: the shared tail, which runs through the asker Abdullah b. al-Sa'ib
«قال سألت عبد الله بن معقل» : the asker is already a link; the one asked (Ibn Ma'qil) answers and is the next link, then Thabit relates the Prophet's prohibition
«وفي رواية ابن أبي شيبة نهى عنها» and «وقال سألت ابن معقل» are version remarks: left out
«ولم يسم عبد الله» is the compiler's remark that one version does not name the asker: not a link
